### Windows x64 2.3.3

Download the [one-file Windows installer](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/download/v2.3.3/ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.3.3-Windows-x64-Setup.exe) for 64-bit Windows 10 (1809 or later) or Windows 11. It installs for your user without administrator rights. The installer is unsigned, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning.

- Add checkmarks, crosses, dated PASS and FAIL stamps, and the Show Annotations toggle in VIEWER.
- Open standards in a dockable reference panel with temporary ink. Word and Excel previews require local LibreOffice.
- Delete every image layer, clear the canvas on close, and remove backgrounds from a dedicated button.
- Keep the preceding slide's background when inserting drawings into PowerPoint.

Tested on Windows 11: upgrade from 2.3.2, launch and reopen, clean reinstall, uninstall, and live PowerPoint insertion. The [Windows source archive](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/download/v2.3.3/eng-drawing-viewer-2.3.3-windows-source.zip), [Windows source references](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/download/v2.3.3/THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES-Windows-x64.txt), and SHA256SUMS.txt accompany the installer.

### macOS Universal 2.3.3

Requires macOS 14.4 or later. Linux remains available from its previous release.

- Add checkmark, cross, PASS, and FAIL markup. PASS and FAIL stamps retain the placement date. VIEWER can display MARK annotations.
- Add a dockable Standards Reference workspace with temporary annotations and local previews for PDFs, text, tables, and iWork documents.
- Send drawings to Pages and Keynote or literal table values to Numbers. iWork previews and direct Keynote insertion may require macOS Automation permission.
- Delete every image layer, clear the canvas on close, and remove backgrounds from a dedicated button.
- Inherit the preceding slide’s background when exporting into PowerPoint.

The packaged app passed native Intel testing. Every Mach-O binary contains both x86_64 and arm64 slices. The arm64 slices of this exact build were checked structurally. The app is ad-hoc signed.

The attached source archive contains the application and build scripts. `THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES.txt` lists corresponding upstream archives, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the release checksums.

### macOS Apple Silicon 2.3.3

Download the [native Apple Silicon DMG](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/download/v2.3.3/ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.3.3-macOS-Apple-Silicon.dmg) for M-series Macs running macOS 14.4 or later. This build was tested on Apple Silicon and is signed ad hoc.

The [corresponding Apple Silicon source archive](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/download/v2.3.3/eng-drawing-viewer-2.3.3-macos-apple-silicon-source.zip) includes the app and its build scripts. The shared checksum file includes both macOS builds and their source archives.
